verdict.rationale: Feature flags and experimentation are a fair axis for an analytics product, since product-analytics competitors often bundle them, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence shows GA4 can create, target, or toggle feature flags. The Data API, Admin API, and official MCP server cover reporting and property configuration only, not flag management, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent create, target, and toggle feature flags through the API or MCP server
